channel.title: Igor Ivitskiy - Selected Thought Leadership
channel.description: Curated selection of Igor Ivitskiy's authored articles on quantitative marketing, Google Ads profitability and applied AI (Profit Forensics, M.A.T.H. Framework).

item.title: The Heuristic Ceiling: A Performance Bound Effort Cannot Break
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: Why past a certain point extra effort on a Google Ads account stops producing profit, framed as a mathematical performance bound.

item.title: The Linear-Exponential Gap: Why Ad Decisions Now Outpace Human Reaction
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: Automated bidding moves at exponential speed while human review stays linear, and what that gap means for advertisers.

item.title: Profit Forensics: From Academic Framework to Diagnostic
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: The Profit Forensics method for auditing where ad budgets actually leak, moved from theory to a working diagnostic.

item.title: The ROAS Fallacy: Why Average Returns Mislead Scaling
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: Average ROAS hides the marginal math that actually governs whether scaling adds or destroys profit.

item.title: The Correlation Trap: Pearl's Adjustment Formula for Marketing
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: Applying causal inference and Pearl's adjustment to separate real ad effects from correlation artifacts.

item.title: Marketing Physics: Treating Ad Markets as Systems
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: A physicist's-eye view of ad auctions as dynamic systems with measurable limits and forces.

item.title: The GIGO Principle Formalized: Why Data Quality Bounds Results
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: A formal bound showing how conversion-data quality caps what any optimization can achieve.

item.title: The Black Box Paradox: Optimizing Against an Untrusted Oracle
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: How to make decisions when the platform's automation is a black box you cannot fully trust.

item.title: Stop Trusting Google's Defaults: A First-Principles Guide
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: A first-principles walk through the Google Ads defaults that quietly cost advertisers money.

item.title: Beyond the Critical Threshold: When Intuition Stops Working
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: The account scale past which human intuition breaks and only explicit models keep working.

item.title: Cognitive Hygiene: Pre-Registration and Adversarial Review
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: Borrowing pre-registration and adversarial review from science to keep marketing decisions honest.

item.title: Cycle Velocity: The Compounding Math of Optimization
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: Why the speed of your optimization loop compounds and often matters more than any single change.

item.title: The Diffraction Limit of Marketing Measurement
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: There is a resolution limit below which marketing measurement cannot distinguish signal from noise.

item.title: The Illusion of Precision: Why Modeled Conversions Distort
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: Modeled conversions look precise and can systematically distort the decisions built on them.

item.title: The M.A.T.H. Framework: A Recursive Loop for Quant Marketing
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: The M.A.T.H. Framework as a recursive loop for running quantitative marketing under noise.

item.title: Observational Collapse: The Vanishing Conversion Funnel
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: How privacy changes collapse the observable funnel and what advertisers can still measure.

item.title: Pausing PerformanceMax Rarely Dents Conversions
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: A data look at what actually happens to total conversions when PerformanceMax is paused.

item.title: The Complete Guide to Google Ads Bid Adjustments
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: A data-driven guide to device, location, audience and schedule bid adjustments in Google Ads.

item.title: Google Ads Target CPA Bidding: A Data-Driven Analysis
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: How Target CPA bidding really behaves across accounts and where it lands versus its promise.

item.title: Mastering Google Ads Portfolio Bid Strategies
item.dc:creator: Igor Ivitskiy
item.description: A definitive guide to portfolio bid strategies and when they help or hurt performance.
